summary: Reproduced all concrete review counterexamples against candidate https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/642 at 68e241ce2eeac7398ab60c704d16bb1c69363e73, then preserved its valid empty-input fix while adding configured top_k and hidden_size width validation. This consolidates the correction requested by review https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/705.

tests.what_was_measured: At exact candidate commit 68e241ce2eeac7398ab60c704d16bb1c69363e73, all four independent GPU counterexamples failed because malformed empty routing widths 0, 1, and 3 and hidden width 15 returned without raising.

Six GPU wrapper tests passed after correction: valid empty contract, nonempty boundary control, mismatched token dimension, routing widths 0/1/3 against top_k=2, and hidden width 15 against hidden_size=16.
The consolidated source, regression, and report changes contain no whitespace errors.
All applicable repository hooks passed, including isort, ruff, ruff-format, codespell, and registered-test CI taxonomy validation.

gpu_execution_evidence: Tests allocated and checked real tensors on one AMD Instinct MI350X with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and HIP 7.2.26015; only the unavailable NVIDIA FlashInfer CUTLASS boundary was instrumented.
remaining_limitations: H20/SM90 FlashInfer CUTLASS kernel execution remains unverified because the assigned GPU is ROCm MI350X.
The four-rank DeepSeek-V4-Flash DP-attention plus TBO end-to-end scenario and real distributed collectives remain unverified because four H20 GPUs and model weights were unavailable.
The regression validates the real SGLang MoeRunner and GPU tensor contract with an instrumented external kernel boundary; it does not claim NVIDIA kernel execution.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
